predicate elem_in_elements(e_opt: option[int], elems: list[option[int]]) {
    (is_some(e_opt) ∧
        (∃(i: int) ::
            (((0 <= i < len(elems)) ∧
                is_some(elems[i])) ∧
                (unwrap(elems[i]) == unwrap(e_opt)))))
}
